_comment: Shared cross-repo golden fixture (round-2 fix directive P2-g7h) for the WBR ledger-summary JSON contract: {week_end, transactions:[{date,name,category,amount}], inflow_total, outflow_total, entity, truncated}. Identical byte-for-byte in accounting-wbr-ledger, sparkry-crm-wbr, and n8n-render — each repo asserts its own side of the contract against this one file rather than three independently hand-written fixtures that can silently drift. Includes: a transfer pair (excluded from inflow_total/outflow_total per P1-tfr3), a card-payment-named transfer row (P0-001/P2-h8d — category='Transfer' AND a name matching the card-payment descriptor pattern, proving the endpoint's exclusion and the CRM's non-re-subtraction agree on the SAME payload shape rather than double-counting it), truncated=true, and a mixed positive/negative amount set.
